subject: Ledgerly onboarding: request to move training + access checklist
messages:
From: Erin Dawson <erin@ledgerly.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: training_ops@ledgerly.com
Date: 2025-07-20T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request to move Monday's onboarding — exec conflict

Hi Marcus,

Quick one — we have an exec all-hands that just moved into the same slot as our Ledgerly onboarding on Monday (July 21). Would you be able to reschedule the console walkthrough + API hands-on? We can do either:

- Tue Jul 22 morning (PST) and Wed Jul 23 morning for two 45-min sessions, or
- Thu Jul 24 afternoon for a single 90–105 min block.

We prefer splitting into two short sessions if possible — it'll let different teams join the parts that matter to them. Attendees will be from Product, Integrations, and our SRE lead (names attached). We still need API credentials; training_ops@ledgerly.com will share those once we confirm times.

Attached: prework-env-checklist.pdf + internal-attendee-list.csv

Can you confirm availability and whether you prefer a split or single session?

Thanks — Erin
Erin Dawson
Head of Integrations, Ledgerly
Erin: 415-555-0192

Subject: Re: Request to move Monday's onboarding — exec conflict

Hi Erin — thanks for the heads-up. Sorry to hear about the conflict.

We can definitely split the work into two 45-minute sessions (recommended):
- Session A: Console walkthrough + admin setup (45 min) — led by Ben
- Session B: API enablement + hands-on lab (45 min) — led by Rishi

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Jul 22: 09:00–10:00 (split into 09:00–09:45 & 09:45–10:30)
- Wed Jul 23: 09:00–10:00 (same split)
- Thu Jul 24: 13:00–15:00 (single block)

If you confirm Tue/Wed mornings we'll send calendar invites for the two 45-min sessions and share a short prework doc. I attached a draft agenda (session-agenda-v1.md) and the checklist you provided looks good — we only need API keys and a test workspace from your side.

Ben and Rishi — can you confirm you're available to lead the two halves on Tue/Wed mornings? If not, propose alternates and we'll re-run.

Also: do you want us to record and share a lightly edited recording after each session?

Thanks,
Marcus
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Confirming:
- Tue Jul 22 — Console walkthrough (09:00–09:45 PST)
- Wed Jul 23 — API hands-on (09:00–09:45 PST)

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Erin

Ben / Rishi — quick check: are the runbooks live in the prework folder the ones you want to reference during Console? If so I'll flag them in the invite.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
